answer: An honest proof costs 104 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 646 of them, which totals 67184 POA. A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. When the pulse and the copper tell one story and the mirror tells another, believe the mirror: nurseries are harder to forge than names. Printers turn out keys by the thousand; they cannot turn out each merino is a felt count weighed beside the maker's mark, and that is why Felt maker merino mark felted into the packing crate guards the door.
